critical_findings.evidence: Current Terrain50 wrapper _run uses subprocess.run without a timeout for both resolver and crosschecker, permitting long-PENDING execution.
Entrypoint records TimeoutExpired but does not prove descendant cleanup or quarantine partial named outputs before later summary reads.
Current numeric gate _run has no timeout for EA, metric, Terrain50 or web subprocesses and emits no stage heartbeat.
EA sampler records per-row SHA but does not reject accidental reuse of one response across distinct row bounds.
Crosschecker concatenates values from every discovered path for a tile, so duplicate ASC files can weight the median more than once.
Crosschecker serializes the Terrain50-minus-EA delta rounded to 3dp and wrapper tiers that serialized value near 4.15m and 8.30m boundaries.
Web verifier hashes fetched members but does not bind HTTP validators or repeat the manifest to prove one response epoch.
No current executable automatically converts a stage older than 15 minutes into a deterministic blocked receipt and existing manual-action update.
